title: Slice the treats
intro: A Christmas slicing game: baubles, candy canes, gingerbread men and presents are thrown up from the bottom of a matrix of the show, and visitors slice them by swiping on their phone (the phone's pad stands for the matrix). A treat is 1 point, a golden star 5, and slicing several with one swipe gives a bonus. Lumps of coal fly too: slicing one costs a life. Alone, or two phones slicing the same treats. Pick the matrix, then Save.
